expectation: Membrane or cytoplasmic signal on a minority of activated/exhausted T cells (mostly CD8, some Treg), often few to rare, scattered through tumour stroma or clustered in lymphoid aggregates, with nuclear-sized cells clearly brighter than background.
observed: A: brightness differs from image to image. Two tiles are lit by an even yellow haze; others show sparse bright specks. B and C: single-pixel grain spread evenly over nuclei and gaps, with no cell-shaped rings. D: grainy haze around one blob.
why: The signal is even pixel grain and haze that changes from image to image, with no distinct cell population at the field or cell scale.
notes: LAG3 shows as speckle spread evenly through both tissue fields and as whole-image haze in some images. No ringed or clustered cell subset stands out, and the brightest spot in D is a lone blob inside grain.
